'''Fulkrehm Protial''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who originally served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. However, after he was injured, he was forced to give up flying and transferred to [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].

==Biography==
Protial was a promising [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] pilot for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Attack on Kostra|attack]] on the world [[Kostra]], he crashed and was exposed to [[trosilon]], a nerve gas that was used by the Empire. Protial was rescued by the natives of Kostra, who treated him for his injuries; however, they lacked sufficient medical knowledge to allow him a full recovery. His motor control skills were irreparably damaged, so Protial could no longer fly or even walk properly.<ref name="CRO" />

Determined to still serve the Alliance, Protial joined [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. He was assigned desk work, and although his work was valued, he began to see the office he worked in as a prison. One night, he noticed a group of drunken pilots returning from a nearby town and he realized that their drunken movements matched his own. The next morning he volunteered to go undercover in [[Sangorn's Net]], a bar that was popular with criminals. Protial's superior, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zeke Rondel|Rondell]], was at first uninterested in sending the former pilot on the assignment, but eventually realized that Protial felt trapped in his current assignment and agreed to it.<ref name="CRO" />

Disguised as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] captain, Protial would spend his nights in various bars throughout the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]], where he would listen to the conversations of those around him. Most patrons of the bars just thought of him as a drunk. He used the identification code "trosilon."<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Protial was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had suffered severe neurological damage from his exposure to an Imperial nerve agent. As a result his movements and speech were heavily impacted so he would stumble and weave as he walked and his speech was heavily slurred. His mental facilities were unimpaired, however, and he remained eager to serve the Rebel Alliance on the front lines as opposed to being confined to an office.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Due to the trosilon damage it was very difficult for Protial to do anything involving fine motor control. He was a good liar and kept his eyes and ears open as he stumbled from bar to bar, and as a result he had a decent knowledge of local criminal activities.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Protial carried four [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]] with [[smartfuse]]s, an audio [[recorder]] disguised as a mini-[[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The comlink had a prerecorded distress call and autolocate feature.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fulkrehm Protial was designed by [[Chuck Truett]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Doug Shuler|Doug Schuler]].
